verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.mistral.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured, agent-oriented documentation links (agents, tools, function calling, MCP, code interpreter, handoffs), directly matching the llms.txt convention for AI-native discovery. First-party docs also detail agent capabilities (tools, MCP, multi-agent handoffs) that such an agent could consume. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that an agent successfully used llms.txt to bootstrap tasks, and no evidence of an OpenAPI spec alongside it (probe shows openapi.json 404s).
